mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tms_carrier (carrier_id, tenant_id, code, name, created_at) VALUES (#{carrierId}, #{tenantId}, #{code}, #{name}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT carrier_id, tenant_id, code, name, created_at FROM tms_carrier WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY code ASC
SELECT shipment_id, tenant_id, order_id, carrier_id, tracking_no, destination_country, status, created_at, updated_at FROM tms_shipment WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tms_tracking_event (tenant_id, event_id, shipment_id, status, location, description, occurred_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{eventId}, #{shipmentId}, #{status}, #{location}, #{description}, #{occurredAt})
mapper.select: SELECT cost_id, tenant_id, shipment_id, carrier_id, freight_cost, fuel_surcharge, other_fees, total_cost, currency, created_at FROM tms_shipping_cost WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tms_shipping_method (method_id, tenant_id, carrier_id, name, type, rate_type, enabled, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{methodId}, #{tenantId}, #{carrierId}, #{name}, #{type}, #{rateType}, #{enabled}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE tms_shipping_method SET name = #{name}, type = #{type}, rate_type = #{rateType}, enabled = #{enabled}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE method_id = #{methodId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
mapper.select: SELECT method_id, tenant_id, carrier_id, name, type, rate_type, enabled, created_at, updated_at FROM tms_shipping_method WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND method_id = #{methodId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tms_shipping_rate (rate_id, tenant_id, method_id, origin, destination, weight_min, weight_max, rate, currency, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{rateId}, #{tenantId}, #{methodId}, #{origin}, #{destination}, #{weightMin}, #{weightMax}, #{rate}, #{currency}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT rate_id, tenant_id, method_id, origin, destination, weight_min, weight_max, rate, currency, created_at, updated_at FROM tms_shipping_rate WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND rate_id = #{rateId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tms_shipping_batch (batch_id, tenant_id, carrier_id, shipment_ids, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{batchId}, #{tenantId}, #{carrierId}, #{shipmentIds}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE tms_shipping_batch SET shipment_ids = #{shipmentIds}, status = #{status}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE batch_id = #{batchId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
mapper.select: SELECT batch_id, tenant_id, carrier_id, shipment_ids, status, created_at, updated_at FROM tms_shipping_batch WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND batch_id = #{batchId}
